title: EQUATOR: A Deterministic Framework for Evaluating LLM Reasoning with Open-Ended Questions. # v1.0.0-beta
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM reasoning and factual accuracy through a deterministic framework (EQUATOR). While it includes a brief mention of ethical considerations in the conclusion and includes one question based on the Trolley Problem in its appendix, it lacks a dedicated component or category for evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics; its taxonomy focuses on logic puzzles, spatial reasoning, counting, and linguistic constraints.
